name: @fluojs/example-react-vite-ssr
description: Vite-backed @fluojs/react streamed SSR and hydration example.

scripts.typegen: node ../../packages/cli/bin/fluo.mjs typegen src/app.ts --export AppModule --options applicationOptions --tsconfig tsconfig.json --output src/generated/react-pages.ts
scripts.typegen:check: node ../../packages/cli/bin/fluo.mjs typegen src/app.ts --export AppModule --options applicationOptions --tsconfig tsconfig.json --output src/generated/react-pages.ts --check
scripts.typegen:watch: node ../../packages/cli/bin/fluo.mjs typegen src/app.ts --export AppModule --options applicationOptions --tsconfig tsconfig.json --output src/generated/react-pages.ts --watch
scripts.build: pnpm typegen:check && vite build --config vite.client.config.ts && vite build --config vite.server.config.ts
scripts.build:reliability: pnpm typegen:check && vite build --mode reliability --config vite.client.config.ts && vite build --mode reliability --config vite.server.config.ts
scripts.test:browser: pnpm --workspace-root build && pnpm build && playwright test --config playwright.config.ts
